nb2_lite.texto: A middle-aged Australian public health doctor, fair skin, greying hair, solid build, white coat over shirt and tie. He holds a former mill worker's chest X-ray against a lit viewing box, reading it. Australian men of predominantly British-descended appearance with fair skin. 1962 Western Australian public health office, wooden desk, Bakelite telephone, filing cabinets. Low-key, the light box the only source. Medium shot, eye-level, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1962, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio.
